text:
Alyssa: Quick async — prepping MPT-30B onboarding for serving. Main asks: where are final weights for AWQ/GPTQ/FP8, any tokenizer quirks (we saw a trailing-space token in earlier runs), and a last config validation before I kick off a canary. Ping @Ben @Carlos @Dina @Eva for ops/calib.

Ben: We pushed the artifacts yesterday. Paths: 
- AWQ: s3://redwood-models/mpt-30b/v3/weights_awq_8bit.pt (sha256: a1b2...)
- GPTQ: s3://redwood-models/mpt-30b/v3/weights_gptq_4bit.pt (sha256: c3d4...)
- FP8: s3://redwood-models/mpt-30b/v3/weights_fp8_v1.pt (sha256: e5f6...)

Ben: Note on naming: the AWQ build includes the per-layer scale table in the same file (loader supports both). Use loader flag `--quant-format awq` or `--quant-format gptq` accordingly.

Carlos: Tokenizer quirk: the HF tokenizer.json we started with has `add_prefix_space: true` for some inputs which shifts offsets for the first token. Two options: reserialize tokenizer with `add_prefix_space=false` or set the serving preprocessor to strip leading spaces for those routes. I recommend updating model metadata to include `tokenizer_serialization: v2` so the console shows the warning.

Dina: Calibration set is ready: s3://redwood-data/calib/mpt30b/2026-11-18/5k.jsonl — 5k samples stratified across code/snippets/chat. Calibration run results (local):
- AWQ (8-bit, per-channel): throughput x3.1, avg latency 48ms, eval delta: -0.7% ROUGE-L
- GPTQ (4-bit): throughput x2.0, latency 82ms, eval delta: -0.2%
- FP8: throughput x1.6, latency 95ms, eval delta: +0.0%

Eva: Quick note on accuracy thresholds — ops wanted <=1.0% relative drop on primary metrics before approval. Based on Dina's numbers AWQ is within threshold (at -0.7%) but sensitive to long-context tokens; we should run a 1k-long-tail probe. I uploaded the probe set to the same bucket: s3://redwood-data/calib/mpt30b/longtail-1k.jsonl

Ben: I ran the config linter against the serve config we plan to use. Config snippet to confirm:
```yaml
model: mpt-30b
quant: awq
kv_cache: true
max_seq_len: 2048
batching:
  dynamic: true
  max_batch_tokens: 65536
rollout:
  canary: 5%
  fallback: gptq
```

deploy-bot: CI check passed: `model-config-lint` OK, `artifact-checksum` OK, `tokenizer-compat` WARNING -> see comment from Carlos.

Carlos: Addendum — the warning is only for legacy chat inputs. If we reserialize tokenizer with `add_prefix_space:false` we get exact parity with evaluation harness. That is the safer path for Hosted API. For Dedicated/Private you can opt for preprocessor fix instead.

Alyssa: Ops question — if we go AWQ in Hosted by default and fallback to GPTQ for long runs, are we good with canary 5% then scale to 25% before full? Also want an explicit approval for AWQ from the accuracy owners.

Eva: I approve AWQ for canary + staged rollout given current deltas, pending the long-tail probe results. If long-tail delta >1.0% revert and use GPTQ fallback. :white_check_mark:

Ben: Filed PR with config change and tokenizer reserialize instructions -> https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/models/pulls/312 (please review).

Dina: I'll kick the long-tail probe tonight and post results here tomorrow morning.

Alyssa: Perfect. Thanks all — I'll schedule the canary for tomorrow 09:00 PT and tag SRE for monitoring. If Dina flags anything >1% we'll rollback. :rocket:
